title: Find Words Containing Character
sourceKind: search-snippets (leetcode.doocs.org mirror and other write-ups; official page not fetchable)
summary: Given an array of strings words and a character x, return the indices of the words that contain x. Indices may be returned in any order.
officialConstraints: Up to 50 words, each up to 50 characters, lowercase English letters (per leetcode.doocs.org mirror of the statement).

examples.source: search snippet citing the statement (dev.to write-up)

visualizationNotes: Visualization caps input at 50 words of up to 50 lowercase letters. Output is listed in ascending index order, which is one of the allowed orders.
